newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Howard says economy will recover next year.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Howard says economy will recover next year.

text.p: Australian Prime Minister John Howard said on Wednesday the economy would recover next year.
"I think a lot of the things that we have done will make it happen next year," Howard told Channel Nine television.
Howard said the economy was mixed with growth figures good, inflation low and interest rates coming down.
"...Although I would like the major banks to bring the small business interest rates down further," he said, adding that it might be possible with more competition.
The government's forecast for gross domestic product growth for the year to June 30 1997 (year-average) is 3.5 percent.
Unemployment stood at 8.8 percent in October, seasonally adjusted.
